title: refactor(rest): move the /meta history family into meta-item-history-routes.ts (#23050 slice 13d)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Sub-slice **13d** of the `rest-server.ts` split: the sixth `/meta` group. Group G6 of `RestServer#registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, the history family, is five statements of 820 lines (base `rest-server.ts:5218`–`:6037` at `93b4acb57`, after the separator line `:5217`), every one a `registerPerItemRoute({ … })`:

| route | statement | range with its leading comments |
|---|---|---|
| `GET {metaPath}/:type/:name/history` | `:5224`–`:5356` | `:5217`–`:5356` |
| `GET {metaPath}/:type/:name/audit` | `:5366`–`:5518` | `:5357`–`:5518` |
| `POST {metaPath}/:type/:name/publish` | `:5522`–`:5710` | `:5519`–`:5710` |
| `POST {metaPath}/:type/:name/rollback` | `:5714`–`:5830` | `:5711`–`:5830` |
| `GET {metaPath}/:type/:name/diff` | `:5834`–`:6037` | `:5831`–`:6037` |

They move, re-indented one level, to a new module, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`, as `registerMetaItemHistoryRoutes`. Like 13c's module, it is a `registerPerItemRoute` pass-through: it registers nothing on the route manager itself.

This follows the slicing plan (`os-dev-report` `6239704287`, sub-slice 13d), seat 1's ruling on it `6239783526` (quoted below), static-receiver ruling A `6205442867`, 13c's `handover_13d` (report `6245538958`), seat 2's hand-off `6246649897` and the claim `6247249133`. PR #24257 (13c, `e9bc60b5a`) is the shape copied.

Nothing else moves:
- the route table, the ordered server registrations, every server-visible handler and every INNER registration (method, path, metadata, arity, handler digest) are identical, base vs head, in 20 configurations;
- the published `dist/index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` are byte-identical, and so are both bundles' 39-name export lists;
- six code tokens of the moved body changed, the ruled receivers, and one comment token was re-anchored because the move made a dead tracker citation an added line for the issue-citation gate (both below).

`rest-server.ts` goes from 7,327 to 6,545 lines on the claim's base (7,357 to 6,575 on `origin/main` `d537a318b`, the merge head's). G7 and G8 (13e), the umbrella `registerMetadataEndpoints` and its guarded swap, the inner head's bindings and `registerPerItemRoute` itself, every handler body, the class head and its members, `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `docs/adr/**` and `packages/spec/src/**` are untouched. #23050 stays open for 13e.

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line above: this is a move. The route table, the inner registrations, every wire answer, the `.d.ts` and the export list stay identical. The one declaration change is `export` on the module-level helper `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` (ruling Q6 B), and `packages/rest/src/index.ts` does not re-export it: measured, `dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are sha256 `e0a7f9586d1d8802…` at base, head and the first merge head, and `e027d7941ba1908e…` at the final head, byte-identical to a build of `main` `d537a318b`; the entry's 39 export names (ESM and CJS) contain no `refuseNonAuthoringCaller`. The reader edits change evidence paths only.

## The ruling this follows (seat 1, `6239783526`, verbatim)

> - **Q1, A.** The four head bindings (`metadata`, `metaPath`, `isScoped`, `registerPerItemRoute`) reach each module as ONE `scope: MetaRouteScope` parameter, built once in the inner head. Each module destructures only what it uses, and body tokens are unchanged. The host stays class members only.
>   - `registerPerItemRoute` stays one closure that reads RestServer's guarded `routeManager` at call time. ⛔ No module-local copy: that would be a second copy of a helper (rule 2).
> - **Q3, A.** `rest-server-registrar-files.ts` exports a named subset, the `/meta` modules. The dogfood census's reachable count becomes "the umbrella's sites plus every site in that subset", and a control pins the subset against the number of module calls inside the inner method. This is declared at 13a with the anonymous-`401` ablation as the runtime proof.
>   - From 13c on, a module with no direct register site is controlled on `registerPerItemRoute(` instead.
>   - ⛔ No naming convention, and ⛔ never "let blindSpot rise".
> - **Q4, A.** `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY`, a `private static readonly` field set once at class evaluation, is handed over by value. 13b and 13d name it in their claims, together with each sub-slice's static-receiver tokens (13 in all, ruling A `6205442867`).
> - **Q6.** […] B for `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` (13d): it stays and is exported, because its callee `mayReadAuthoringTrail` is a docs anchor (`system-context.mdx:108`). […]
>
> **Binding on every sub-slice (from the plan's measurements):**
> - **Hosts are built inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`**, at the position of the statements they replace, with `routeManager` passed by value. ⛔ Never in `registerRoutes`, the constructor, an instance cache or the umbrella above the swap: those capture the real manager, and the moved routes would mount outside the anonymous-deny gate (#3963) and the type-level admissions (#21087, #21124).
>   - Each sub-slice proves this with the guard ablation in the plan: an anonymous request at every moved route gets `401` on head, and the ablation does not.
> - **The proof gains an inner-registration leg.** Slice 12's handler digest is blind to `/meta`, because every route's server-visible handler is the same guard wrapper. So each sub-slice digests the inner handlers through a recording `routeManager` and a direct `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` call per base, with the ruled receiver tokens mapped back. A one-character positive control must move exactly that route's inner digest.
>   - The full-boot legs stay: `getRoutes()`, ordered registrations, `.d.ts`/`.d.cts`, and the 39-name export list.
>   - The config matrix is slice 12's 13 configs plus the `/meta` switches the plan names.
> - **Readers move in the same PR**, loud and silent alike, as the plan lists per sub-slice. […] The `system-context.mdx` rows change with the sub-slice that moves their code.

The maintainer's rule on this card, verbatim: 「每片只搬代码、路由表前后一致、门禁和文档锚点同 PR 迁完。」

## The shape

**Moved, at its position.** In the inner method, right after 13c's `registerMetaItemWriteRoutes.call(itemWriteHost, scope);`, the head now builds the host literal `itemHistoryHost` and calls `registerMetaItemHistoryRoutes.call(itemHistoryHost, scope)` with the ONE existing `scope` (no second one is built). Registration order is unchanged: after the per-item writes, above the object FSM read (G7).

**The host, `MetaItemHistoryRouteHost`: 15 members in first-read order** (a symbol-resolved walk of G6 with the TypeScript 6.0.3 compiler API, the plan's method; no bare `this`, no `this[...]`, no `function` keyword, no assignment to a `this` member, no `arguments`, no `super`):

| member | reads | handed over as |
|---|---:|---|
| `resolveExecCtx` | 5 | closure `(...a) => this.resolveExecCtx(...a)`, spelled exactly as the execctx census's forwarder |
| `resolveProtocol` | 5 | closure |
| `eventDoorRefusal` | 2 (history, audit) | closure |
| `walledCatalogRefusal` | 2 (publish, rollback) | closure |
| `resolveMetaWriteActor` | 2 (publish, rollback) | closure |
| `metaTypeSingular` (private static) | 1 (diff) | closure `(...a) => RestServer.metaTypeSingular(...a)` |
| `resolveObjectMasker` | 1 (diff) | closure |
| `gatesPerCaller` (private static) | 1 (diff) | closure on the class |
| `fetchCurrentMetaDocument` | 1 (diff) | closure |
| `gatesOnItsOwnKey` (private static) | 1 (diff) | closure on the class |
| `diffSides` (private static) | 1 (diff) | closure on the class |
| `metaItemReadGate` | 1 (diff) | closure |
| `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` (private static readonly field) | 1 (diff) | BY VALUE (Q4 A) |
| `diffEmittedFrom` (private static) | 1 (diff) | closure on the class |
| `maskObjectDocument` | 1 (diff) | closure |

**No `routeManager` member.** All five statements register through `registerPerItemRoute`, which reaches the module in `scope` as the inner head's ONE closure (Q1 A, ⛔ no module-local copy). That closure reads the server's `this.routeManager` at call time; every call runs during the inner call, inside the umbrella's swap, so all five routes still mount behind the wrapping registrar and still answer to `metadata.endpoints.item`, which the same closure reads. No member is a getter: the body reads no instance field at request time.

**The six ruled receiver tokens (ruling A `6205442867`, Q4 A), all in the `diff` handler:** `RestServer.metaTypeSingular(` → `this.metaTypeSingular(`, `RestServer.gatesPerCaller(` → `this.gatesPerCaller(`, `RestServer.gatesOnItsOwnKey(` → `this.gatesOnItsOwnKey(`, `RestServer.diffSides(` → `this.diffSides(`, `RestServer.STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` → `this.STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY`, `RestServer.diffEmittedFrom(` → `this.diffEmittedFrom(`. Each static reads nothing but its arguments (`gatesPerCaller` still asks `gatesOnItsOwnKey` on the class).

**Module-level names.**
- **Stays in `rest-server.ts` and gains `export` (Q6 B):** `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` (history, audit and diff call it), beside its callee `mayReadAuthoringTrail`, the `system-context.mdx:108` anchor; a one-paragraph pointer is added to its docblock. Row 108 is unchanged.
- **Already exported, imported from `./rest-server.js`:** the five closed sets `META_ITEM_HISTORY_PARAMS`, `META_ITEM_AUDIT_PARAMS`, `META_ITEM_PUBLISH_PARAMS`, `META_ITEM_ROLLBACK_PARAMS`, `META_ITEM_DIFF_PARAMS` (the door tests import them from there), `readDeclaredQueryNumber` and `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` (approvals, data-action and search import them from there), `metaItemPackageBinding` and `sendMetaItemAbsent`. Each is read only at request time.
- **Imports that left `rest-server.ts` with the body (six, measured):** `HistoryMetaItemRequestSchema` and `AuditMetaItemRequestSchema` (the whole value import), the types `PublishMetaItemRequest`, `AuditMetaItemRequest`, `HistoryMetaItemRequest`, and `metaMemberSelector`. The plan named five; `metaMemberSelector` is the sixth because its other readers left with 13b and 13c, so G6 held its last three reads (`noUnusedLocals` would red the leftover import). A pointer comment stands at each old position, and the `thrownAnswerIsBareNotFound` import comment now says the diff door's catch moved too and the class's event-door refusal still reads it.
- Every other name is imported from the module `rest-server.ts` imports it from; `MetaRouteScope` and `TransportScopedMetaRequest` from `./meta-collection-routes.js`.

## Proof

Builds, suites, dumps, controls and ablations ran through `os-verify-lock`, every exit captured before any pipe; the short `tsx` probes ran unlocked (see Deviations). The base is `93b4acb57` (the claim's). The head is `56a51a837`; the merge head `93027d839` adds one merge of `origin/main` `1e001c7df` (#24270, #24269: `packages/spec`, `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/runtime`, `packages/client`, `packages/objectql` tests), with no path in common with this diff; `2c02e0a0d` is the comment edit above (legs 1–4 re-run there: the source dump byte-identical to the head's in all 80 files, the rebuilt bundle equal to base under the declared normalization, `.d.ts` unchanged). The final head `03ac3135e` merges `origin/main` `d537a318b` a second time, because it brought PR #24267 (the class head of `rest-server.ts`, `metaItemReadGateSources` and `serveMetaItemLayered`, and `meta-item-read-gate.ts`) and PR #24274 (row 29b of `system-context.mdx`), both textually disjoint from this diff, as the claim recorded; the merge was clean and this branch's delta against `main` is still exactly its 17 files, +1210 / −853. Re-measured against that `main` (built from a detached checkout of `d537a318b`): `index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` are byte-identical to `main`'s, the 39-name export list is unchanged, and the source and bundle dumps of all 20 configs equal `main`'s: 60 of 60 full-boot files and 688 of 688 inner digests under the same mapping and normalization (raw, only `GET …/diff`'s 36 differ, the receivers), with the concatenation hashes quoted below, which `main`'s merge moved none of. The bundle identifier-set diff against `main`'s ESM bundle is the same five head-only names, none lost.

**1. The moved text.** Base `rest-server.ts:5218`–`:6037`, with one 4-space indent removed, against `meta-item-history-routes.ts:177`–`:996` (the body after the destructuring line), at the final head: the raw `diff` exits 1 on exactly seven lines, the six receivers and one comment line; with the six `this.X` mapped back to `RestServer.X` and that comment line mapped back, `diff` exits 0 over all 820 lines, both sides sha256 `51dc0cccdc000123dbd57fa5fb528ed2a5a96c61dd73c357ef74fa28024134cc`. Every non-empty line (814) carried the 8-space indent; no tab, no trailing whitespace.

**The one comment edit.** The audit door's moved comment called `auditMetaItem`'s declaration "the #11006-pattern catch-up". `check-issue-citations` judges the lines a change ADDS, so the move made that pre-existing citation an added line, and it does not resolve: `--probe-cause` reads it `[deleted]` ("minted, gone from the board, and the web endpoint 404s too"), exit 2. The gate's own remedy is to name a target that resolves, and the re-anchor sweeps that cleaned `packages/rest/src` used the deciding commit: the line now reads "(the commit-cccbe51bf-pattern", `cccbe51bf` being the landing of that card's ruling ("feat(spec): declare publishMetaItem as optional MetadataProtocol member with PublishMetaItemRequest", read through the REST API, since this clone's history starts after it). Comment text only: esbuild drops comments, and every source and bundle digest at the final head equals the one before the edit. With it the gate reads `77 resolves, 1 resolves-as-pull-request` and exits 0.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports.** `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are sha256 `e0a7f9586d1d8802b2b2922b957401a02f03818db56779dfa347534db20732ca` at base, at head, at the first merge head and at `2c02e0a0d`; at the final head they are `e027d7941ba1908e700d18bcd37ae6b26241e4bca7a4fcb11364305e3b204fd9`, byte-identical to a build of `main` `d537a318b` (#24267 moved them, not this diff). The head-only marker `registerMetaItemHistoryRoutes` hits 2 in each of `index.js` / `index.cjs` at head and merge head, 0 at base. Both bundles load with 39 exports and one sorted name list, sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…`, ESM == CJS, base and head (13c's reading too).

**3. Full-boot legs, 20 configurations:** slice 12's thirteen, then the `/meta` switches under scoped-optional (`metadata.endpoints.types`, `.items`, `.item`, `.maintenance` each false; all four false; `metadata.prefix: '/metadata'`; `api.enableMetadata: false`). Route counts 75 / 150 / 75 / 75 / 73 / 73 / 142 / 148 / 148 / 138 / 144 / 138 / 150 / 146 / 148 / 126 / 144 / 114 / 150 / 112, the same on both trees.
- **Source leg** (a `tsx` boot of `src/rest-server.ts`): `routes.json`, `calls.json` and `handlers.json` byte-identical in all 20 configs, 60 of 60, concatenation sha256 `e73a487e4cfc05ab…` on both trees. A second base run was identical to the first (`diff -r` exit 0).
- **Bundle leg** (the same dump against the built `dist/index.js`, the base bundle loaded from a copy): 60 of 60 identical, concatenation `d1db493b81aaf53e…`, under one declared normalization, esbuild's numeric alias suffix on an import name two bundled modules share. Measured by an identifier-set diff of the two bundles, the ESM head gains exactly `itemHistoryHost`, `registerMetaItemHistoryRoutes` and three renumbered aliases (`ObjectSchemaMaskEvaluationError4`, `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict3`, `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable6`) and loses none; those three names are the ones normalized. Unnormalized, the 19 configs that mount `/meta` differ only in `handlers.json` (the umbrella wrapper spells `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable` under a shifted suffix). The CJS bundle gains `itemHistoryHost`, `registerMetaItemHistoryRoutes`, `import_core39` and `import_metadata_core18`.

**4. The inner-registration leg.** Each config builds a `RestServer` with a recording `routeManager` and calls `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` directly for `/api/v1` and `/api/v1/environments/:environmentId`: 688 recorded registrations over the 20 configs (13c's count), digested whitespace-free with the ruled receiver tokens of 13a–13d mapped back, together with method, path, metadata and arity.
- **Source leg:** 688 of 688 identical, same order; digest-list sha256 `2fab0c3853495542…` on both trees. Unnormalized, exactly 36 digests differ: `GET …/diff` on both bases in the 18 configs that mount it, the six receivers. The other four moved routes are identical raw.
- **Bundle leg:** 688 of 688 identical under the three alias names; digest-list sha256 `0dcff1d8b81a295d…` on both trees (unnormalized, `GET …/published`, G8, also differs: the same alias shift, in a body this PR does not touch).
- **Positive controls** (one character each, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0): the audit door's 501 message gained a `!` (module blob `6b11bab3ccac` → `cdb207236e6f`), then, separately, the publish door's (→ `7f57a79d8125`). Each moved the inner digests of exactly its own route, on both bases, in the 18 configs that mount it: 36 of 688 each, and nowhere else; all 20 configs' full-boot files stayed byte-identical (60 of 60), the blind spot the inner leg covers. Restored each time: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**5. H2: the handed-over closure is the inner method's own.** An anonymous request at each moved route on both bases (one-off `tsx` probe, scoped-optional), base and head byte-identical:
- `endpoints.item` on: all ten mounts answer `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` with zero protocol calls, and all ten server-visible handlers are the umbrella's wrapper.
- `endpoints.item: false`: the five routes are gone on both bases (150 → 126 routes, 0 moved mounts), on both trees.

**6. The guard ablation** (the plan's shape for 13c, 13d and 13e-published). Three literal anchors, nested: the umbrella stashes its `realRouteManager` captured above the swap (`rest-server.ts` blob `cb30c8a7e5b6` → `e5933a89b85f`), `itemHistoryHost` carries it as a `routeManager` member (→ `f019c09637fa`), and the module replaces the scope's `registerPerItemRoute` with a module-local registrar that honours the same switch but registers on that host member (module blob `6b11bab3ccac` → `9614ca62b428`).
- **Ablation:** an anonymous request at all ten mounts answers `403 FORBIDDEN` from the doors' own authoring and capability gates, not `401`, with zero protocol calls, and none of the ten handlers is the wrapper. Under `endpoints.item: false` the routes are still gone, so the switch alone cannot tell the two shapes apart; the gate can.
- **Standing pins under the ablation:** `Test Files 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`, `Tests 21 failed | 109 passed (130)`: `meta-type-read-capability.test.ts` red 12 times (#21087, the datasource-family read shapes for member, other-grant and author), `meta-type-write-capability.test.ts` red 8 times (#21124, the write shapes and the existing-vs-absent byte identity), `rest-meta-auth.test.ts` red once (#3963 / #15542, the helper-routed per-item route's anonymous `401`). `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` and `meta-route-registration-order.test.ts` stay green.
- Restored, both files: each blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No permanent test was added.

**7. The late-binding ablation** (one-off script). The 9 instance methods are planted on the server and the 5 static methods on the class before `registerRoutes()`, as recorders; seven request shapes are driven over the five moved routes (history and diff on an `object` and on a `view`, audit, publish, rollback), each answering 200, then everything is planted again and the shapes are driven again.
- **Head** (`MEASURE` lines byte-identical to base): all 14 closure members are reached before and after the re-plant, `early calls after re-plant: 0`.
- **Ablation:** `eventDoorRefusal: this.eventDoorRefusal.bind(this)` (blob `cb30c8a7e5b6` → `601b3610bc89`) gives `early calls after re-plant: 3 ["early:eventDoorRefusal"]` and 13 late members, exit 1. Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

`rest-server-registrar-files.ts` gains `meta-item-history-routes.ts` in `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES` (length 16 → 17) and in the named `/meta` subset `REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES` (3 → 4). The dogfood control counts `.call(` inside the inner method, now 4, so the subset and the call moved together.

| reader | sum over the list | change |
|---|---|---|
| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 5 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 6 + 3 + 1 + 2 + 5; mentions 141 → 145 | The five sites moved, all locally caught as before (audit, publish, rollback on their invocation lines; history and diff on their continuation lines, two of §7's and §8's four). The four new mentions are the seam: the forwarder, two, and the host interface's member, two. `rest-server.ts` goes 55 → 52. Seventeen forwarders = (17 − 1) + 3 − 2 |

| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:459` | anchor resolves to G6 | `rest-server.ts#toVersion` → `meta-item-history-routes.ts#registerMetaItemHistoryRoutes` (the 13a precedent for `#route`) |
| `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__meta-item-history-routes.ts.json` (new) | 1783 decision letters, restored | ADR-0067, ADR-0106, ADR-0066 and ADR-0131, with the invariant the bodies' citations carry |

**Red before the re-points, in two stages (each reader read the readers' base text).**
- **Move commit `337889b10`, list not grown:** the six list readers `Tests 7 failed | 121 passed (128)` (execctx 57 vs 62 sites, caught same-line 9 vs 12, §7 control 9 vs at least 12, §8 control 2 vs at least 4; query-number: the rollback row names no site, its positive control false, 8 vs 9 sites); dogfood `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)` (population 65 vs 70; `.call(` 4 vs a subset of 3); `check:route-envelope` exit 1 (NOT DECLARED, and `rest-server.ts` found 2 vs declared 7 and 2 vs 3); `check-system-context-census` exit 1 (`[file-without-a-row]` the module, 2 reads in 1 symbol; `[anchor-is-not-a-read-site]` `rest-server.ts#registerMetadataEndpointsInner`); `check-adr-anchors` silently green at 1765 decision letters vs base 1783.
- **List grown `099ef9a27`, readers at base text:** local `Tests 7 failed | 123 passed (130)`, repo `Tests 2 failed | 93 passed | 17 skipped (112)`, dogfood `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)` (the length pins and the new module's control).
- **The silent reader, measured:** `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs#symbolResolutionClass` reads `rest-server.ts#toVersion` as `declaration` at base (G6's `const toVersion`) and as `literal` at head (the `'toVersion'` of `META_ITEM_ROLLBACK_PARAMS`): still resolving, now about the wrong thing. The new anchor reads `declaration` in the module.
- **Examined, not edited:** `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` derives the item, tree and layers GET handlers by path (G6 holds none); `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` (the `endpoints.item` evidence names the inner head's `registerPerItemRoute`, which stays; no `packages/spec` edit); `system-context.mdx` row 108 and `docs/adr/0119:118` `#NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (resolve outside G6).

## Verification at the final head `03ac3135e`

Under `os-verify-lock`, each exit captured before any pipe (wall clocks are shared-box readings):
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, 0 file(s) / 0 error(s)).
- `@objectstack/rest` `local` (`vitest run --project local`): exit 0, `Test Files 295 passed (295)`, `Tests 6049 passed | 326 skipped (6375)`.
- `@objectstack/rest` `repo`: exit 0, `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 274 passed | 17 skipped (291)`.
- dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` + `authz-conformance.test.ts`: exit 0, `Tests 108 passed (108)`.
